oracle.signature: int4 ActionHeritage::apply(Funcdata &data); void Funcdata::opHeritage(void); void Heritage::heritage(void); int4 LocationMap::findPass(const Address &addr) const

architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; register delay=0, stack delay=1
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the production boundary Funcdata::opHeritage (funcdata.hh:462) once (case A), three times (case B), twice (case C/D) on a fresh Funcdata; no Action tree, no C emission; the pass counter is read after the calls (C++ getHeritagePass / Rust num_heritage_passes)
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata built through production APIs (newOp/opSetOpcode/opSetInput/opSetOutput/newUniqueOut/newConstant/newVarnode/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic/addEdge). Both sides apply the startProcessing steps a synthetic graph can reach: structureLoops+calcForwardDominator (Ghidra) mirrors as find_spanning_tree (BLOCK-INDEX-ASSIGN-0001) + BlockGraph::build_dom_tree, then heritage.buildInfoList (funcdata.cc:166). Every read is a fresh free Varnode with exactly one descendant, mirroring the PcodeEmitFd::dump single-descendant invariant (funcdata.cc:878-908)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: pass counter; Heritage::heritagePass (heritage.hh:325) at the same offset in the register and the stack space (C++ LocationMap::findPass / Rugra globaldisjoint.find_pass); read input descriptors after rename; live op count; whole-bank free-with-descendant census (varnode.cc:334-336 throw precondition); phi projection (block-index/block-position order, output descriptor, per-slot input descriptor with the in-edge predecessor index); full op list in SeqNum order as name.OPCODE(input descriptors); sorted Varnode descriptor multiset. Case D additionally prints the op count captured after pass 0 (re-entry must not add ops)
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, or membership normalization; absolute unique-space offsets are not printed because allocation bases differ between the implementations; descriptors carry space class, offset or size, def-use class, and defining opcode

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: switch_written_read: single block b0 with w=INT_SUB(C1:0,C1:1) writing register 0x30:8 and r=INT_OR(fresh free R0x30:8, C8:11) with unique output plus a CBRANCH; ONE opHeritage (pass 0). The read links to the write (R30:8:W+INT_SUB), hp_reg=0, hp_stack=-1, free_with_reader=0.

switch_diamond_reherit: b0->{b1,b2}->b3 diamond with w1=INT_SUB and w2=INT_OR both writing register 0x38:8 and r=INT_ADD(fresh free R0x38:8, C8:6) at the join; THREE opHeritage calls (the repeatapply mainloop re-entry shape). pass=3, one phi at b3 head with reverse-predecessor slot wiring, op set stable across re-runs (idempotence).

switch_cross_space: b0->b1 chain with wr=INT_SUB writing register 0x30:8 and ws=INT_OR writing STACK 0x30:8 in b0, and rr=INT_ADD(free R0x30:8)/rs=INT_ADD(free S0x30:8) in b1 plus RETURN; TWO opHeritage calls (register delay 0, stack delay 1). hp_reg=0 and hp_stack=1 — two disjoint LocationMap entries at the same offset (the space identity of map<Address,SizePass>); each read links to its OWN space's write.

switch_late_free_reentry: b0->b1 with w=INT_SUB writing register 0x40:8, r1=INT_OR(free R0x40:8) and RETURN; opHeritage (pass 0); then a NEW free read r2=INT_ADD(R0x40:8) is injected (post-heritage churn) and opHeritage runs again (pass 1). The prev==2 OLD range re-enters (heritage.cc:2711-2719) and absorbs the fresh read into the existing write with zero new ops.

switch_refinement_recollect: b0->b1 with w=INT_SUB writing register 0x50:4 (partial write) and r=INT_ADD(fresh free R0x50:8) plus RETURN; ONE opHeritage. The 8-byte range has max write 4 < 8 so placeMultiequals refines it into two 4-byte pieces (cc:2610-2616); the LIVE beginLoc/endLoc re-collect (cc:2615) sees the refineRead/refineWrite pieces (cc:1902-1906) — the second piece gets its own promoted input (R54:4:I) and a PIECE op reassembles the full-width read (U8:W+PIECE). An entry-frozen snapshot hides the pieces (review M1): the fixture asserts free_with_reader=0, which the frozen implementation fails.
